prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image: edit target, an eight-cell Miku running animation sheet, exactly four columns and two rows on real transparent background.
Primary request: repair sprite-sheet packing artifacts. Preserve all eight existing character drawings, their faces, hair colors, clothes, anatomical poses and which arm is in front or behind. In each equal-sized square cell, keep ONLY that cell's complete Miku. Remove the stray white/cyan curved pieces at cell boundaries that belong to a neighboring character. Remove disconnected residual colored pixels and neon outlines in the otherwise transparent background.
Packing: keep exactly the same 4 by 2 grid and ordering, with uniform equal square cells. Slightly reduce every complete character uniformly to about 88% of cell width/height and center it within its own cell, leaving a completely transparent gutter of at least 5% on ALL four edges of EVERY cell. Preserve full twin-tails, headphones, hands, sleeves, and both boots without clipping. No character or hair may spill into another cell. Keep each character's pose and expression unchanged. This is a precise cleanup of existing artwork, NOT a redesign and NOT new animation poses. No grid lines, panel borders, text, extra elements, shadows, background, or white fill. Deliver PNG with real alpha transparency.
